original_test_intent: Verify each Type 4 Processor Part Number string matches the approved CPU ordering/inventory identifier or supported absent value for that socket and remains correct after reboot; it must not be conflated with the processor version/brand string.
original_method: Capture complete raw/decoded Type 4 records, retain part-number string index/value per socket/handle, apply only approved normalization and absence handling, compare with the authoritative CPU inventory, reboot and repeat.
manual_activity: A user approves the authoritative part-number baseline, supported blank policy, normalization and reboot plan. Core collection and comparison are automatable.
required_inputs: Expected processor part number per socket or explicit unsupported/blank policy
Authoritative CPU BOM/inventory and Type 4 socket/handle mapping
Definition separating part number from Processor Version/brand and serial fields
Validated parser plus approved reboot and OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS collection; do not hotplug CPUs, program metadata or modify firmware.
Preserve raw string index and full Type 4 context because generic grep can capture Part Number from another SMBIOS structure.
Do not derive acceptance from CPU brand text or CPUID when the case requires the distinct Part Number field.
Treat blank/placeholder as valid only when explicitly approved and distinguish it from malformed string references.
Stop on mapping ambiguity, unexpected mixed-CPU value, unapproved drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect complete Type 4 records, resolve Part Number strings by socket, normalize under policy and compare with the approved CPU inventory before/after reboot.
Do not write metadata, substitute Processor Version/brand for Part Number or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the CPU part-number inventory, field scope, blank and normalization rules.
Approve reboot/recovery and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label target is relevant, but grep suppresses errors, can match other SMBIOS structure types and omits string-index/socket evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 4 records, retain handle/socket/string index and compare the exact Part Number field with the authoritative CPU BOM under approved normalization.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Part Number scope, Type 4 script and 10/10-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Resolve the Type 4 Part Number string for each expected socket, keep it distinct from brand/version/serial fields, validate approved absence semantics and compare with the authoritative CPU BOM before and after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 4 systems where the Part Number field is represented.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS, CPU BOM, processor population and parser/dmidecode versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 4 Part Number string semantics, approved platform CPU BOM and installed tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw string provenance, field-scope separation and BOM-based per-socket validation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; avoids a false match against a similarly named component field or marketing brand string.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: CPU BOM/part-number map and absence/normalization policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The firmware string may be unavailable even when CPUID and brand identify the CPU; absence requires explicit platform approval.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve exact part numbers, a controlled alias set for equivalent SKUs or a documented blank state. It must not silently replace the field with Processor Version or a decoded CPUID model.
expected_evidence: Approved per-socket part-number/BOM baseline, field scope, absence/normalization rules and tool versions
Complete pre-reboot Type 4 capture with handle/socket/raw string index and resolved Part Number
Comparison with the authoritative CPU inventory and any approved equivalent-SKU mapping
Approved reboot/health evidence and equivalent post-reboot comparison
Engineer verdict with documented blank or alias rationale

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item and criteria consistently target the Part Number string; the authoritative content is a project input.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The field can be read and compared safely once the BOM/absence policy is supplied.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains inventory normalization while correcting capability to FULLY AUTOMATABLE and separating engineer verdict.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Explicitly prevents substitution of Processor Version, brand or CPUID for the requested Part Number field.

review_improvement: Avoids both cross-structure grep false matches and false confidence from comparing a different CPU identifier.
independent_technical_reasoning: With an approved BOM and string policy, all core collection, mapping, normalization and reboot persistence checks are software-controlled.
